info.title: CAP-001 Retail Banking API — Credit Card Application Surface
info.description: CAP-001 Retail Banking capability API surface for the credit card application and issuance journey (JRN-008). Credit cards are within CAP-001 (SVC-003 Credit Card Service is within the Retail Banking capability boundary). Channels and internal tooling call this capability API; they never address SVC-003 directly. Covers the credit card application lifecycle from submission through to account activation and ongoing statement retrieval. All cross-capability integrations (credit scoring via CAP-004 Risk Management) are mediated exclusively via async events and are not exposed as synchronous API endpoints. PCI DSS v4.0 compliance: no raw PAN (Primary Account Number) is returned in any API response. card_number_token is used exclusively.

tags.name: credit-card-applications
tags.description: Credit card application lifecycle — from submission through to decision

tags.name: credit-card-accounts
tags.description: Credit card account management — activation, statement retrieval

post.description: Submits a new credit card application at PH-023. Creates an ENT-022 CreditCardApplication record with status = 'submitted'. Runs automated eligibility pre-checks (active customer, UK resident, product eligibility). Publishes EVT-040 CreditCardApplicationSubmitted. Returns 202 Accepted — the credit decision is asynchronous (credit check dispatched via EVT-041 to SVC-012). Customer should poll GET /credit-card-applications/{id} or receive push notification when decision is ready.

202.description: Application accepted. Credit check in progress. Decision will be communicated via push notification and email. Use GET /credit-card-applications/{id} to poll status.

example.message: Your application is being processed. A credit check is in progress. You will be notified of the decision shortly.

400.description: Invalid request — missing required fields, invalid employment_status enum value, hard_credit_check_consent must be true.

409.description: Conflict — customer_id already has an open credit card application in progress (status: submitted or assessment_complete). Only one in-flight application permitted per customer.

422.description: Eligibility pre-check failed — customer does not meet product eligibility criteria (e.g. not UK resident, below minimum age, product withdrawn). Hard credit check NOT performed.

get.summary: Retrieve a credit card application by ID
get.description: Retrieves the current state of a credit card application. Used to poll for the decision after submitting at POST /credit-card-applications. Returns the full application status including decision fields (assigned_credit_limit, apr) once the decision phase (PH-025) is complete. The customer may only retrieve their own application (customer_id in JWT must match application.customer_id).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The application_id (UUID v4) returned at application submission.

404.description: Application not found for the given id.

403.description: Forbidden — the authenticated customer does not own this application.

post.description: Activates a credit card at PH-027. Transitions ENT-023 CreditCardAccount status from 'issued' to 'active'. Requires a valid SCA session token (PSR 2017 Reg. 100 — SCA mandatory for remote card activation). Publishes EVT-046 CreditCardActivated. Idempotent — if the card is already active, returns 200 with the current account status. PCI DSS: no raw PAN in request or response — card_number_token used.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account_id (UUID v4) of the CreditCardAccount (ENT-023).

200.description: Card activated successfully (or already active — idempotent response).

400.description: Invalid request — missing or invalid sca_session_token, invalid card_number_token format.

403.description: Forbidden — SCA session token invalid or expired (PSR 2017 Reg. 100). Customer must re-authenticate.

404.description: Account not found for the given id.

409.description: Account is not in 'issued' status — cannot activate. Account may already be active, suspended, or closed.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of StatementCycle records (ENT-025) for a credit card account. Covers PH-028 ongoing management. The default lookback is 13 months (sufficient for annual statement review). Maximum supported: 84 months (7 years — CCA retention). Statements do not contain full PAN — card_number_token or masked last 4 digits only (PCI DSS compliant).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The account_id (UUID v4) of the CreditCardAccount (ENT-023).

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of months of statement history to retrieve (most recent first). Default: 13. Maximum: 84.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of statements per page. Default: 12. Maximum: 24.

403.description: Forbidden — the authenticated customer does not own this account.

BearerAuth.description: JWT issued by the bank's Identity Provider. Claims must include customer_id (sub) and scope credit-cards:read credit-cards:write as appropriate.

Unauthorised.description: Unauthorised — missing or invalid Bearer token.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error. Retry with exponential backoff. If persistent, contact credit-cards-engineering@bank.internal.

customer_id.description: The customer's UUID (ENT-001.customer_id). Must match the customer_id in the JWT Bearer token.

product_id.description: The selected CardProduct UUID (ENT-024.product_id). Must reference an active CardProduct.

income_declared.description: Gross annual income in GBP (self-declared). Used for CONC 5.3A creditworthiness assessment. Not shared with credit bureaux.

requested_limit.description: Optional preferred credit limit in GBP. If null, the system assigns based on creditworthiness. Actual assigned limit may be lower than requested.

hard_credit_check_consent.description: Must be true. Customer consents to a hard credit check (bureau footprint). Cannot be false — a hard check is mandatory for a credit card application.

application_id.description: The newly created application ID. Store this to poll for the decision.

product_name.description: Human-readable product name for UI display.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of application submission.

message.description: Human-readable status message for display in the customer-facing UI.

decision.description: Decision field. Null before PH-025 completes.

assigned_credit_limit.description: Assigned credit limit in GBP. Null unless decision = 'approved'.

apr.description: Assigned APR as percentage (e.g. 24.9). Null unless decision = 'approved'.

decline_reason_summary.description: High-level decline reason for customer display (CONC 7.3 — proportionate reason; not the full score). Present only when decision = 'declined'.

cra_used.description: Name of the credit reference agency consulted (CCA 1974 s157 right-to-know). Present only when decision = 'declined'.

resulting_account_id.description: The ENT-023 CreditCardAccount ID created on approval. Null for declined or in-progress applications.

card_number_token.description: The card_number_token from ENT-023 (PCI DSS: token only — no raw PAN accepted or returned).

activation_method.description: Activation method. Only 'explicit_app' is valid for this endpoint. 'first_transaction' activation is handled automatically by the card authorisation path (JRN-011).

sca_session_token.description: A valid SCA session token proving the customer has completed two-factor authentication (PSR 2017 Reg. 100). Issued by the bank's Identity Provider after successful SCA challenge.

card_number_token.description: PCI-safe token. No raw PAN returned.

available_balance.description: Available balance in GBP (credit_limit minus any outstanding balance).

first_statement_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the first scheduled statement (statement_date_day of the following month).

statement_date.description: The date on which this billing cycle closed.

opening_balance.description: Balance at the start of the billing cycle (GBP).

closing_balance.description: Balance at the end of the billing cycle (GBP).

payments_received.description: Total payments received during this cycle (GBP).

minimum_payment_due.description: Minimum payment due by payment_due_date (GBP). Covers interest + fees + minimum principal (CONC 7.7).

payment_due_date.description: Payment due date — at least 25 days after statement_date (FCA CONC minimum).

persistent_debt_months.description: Snapshot of persistent_debt_months counter at this statement date. For FCA CONC 6.7.27 monitoring.

total_statements.description: Total number of statements in the requested lookback window.

statements.description: Statements ordered by statement_date descending (most recent first).

reason.description: Human-readable eligibility failure reason. Possible values: 'not_uk_resident', 'below_minimum_age', 'product_withdrawn', 'existing_card_limit_reached'.

message.description: Customer-facing message. Must be clear, fair, and not misleading (Consumer Duty PS22/9).
message.example: We are unable to process this application as the selected product requires UK residency.

request_id.description: Request correlation ID for support and tracing.
